name: K-Bot
summary: An open-source general-purpose humanoid from K-Scale Labs, a startup founded by a former Tesla AI engineer aiming to do for humanoids what open platforms did for PCs. K-Scale publishes hardware designs and a simulation-to-real software stack (K-Sim, K-OS) and sells developer kits.
notable: Open hardware plus an open sim-to-real software stack

sources.title: K-Scale Labs — Y Combinator company profile
